desc: Implement the linear-time remainder DP with separate states for moduli 1 through 9.
Ensure the transition preserves all substring-start states and adds the one-character state.
Exclude substrings ending in digit zero and correctly count single-digit nonzero substrings.
Verify the three provided sample cases, including leading zeros.
Provide the final `Solution.countSubstrings` implementation with integer accumulation.
